field.label: Serve Product Listings From Documents
field.comment: Per store view: category and search listing pages build their products from documents instead of loading their attributes. A page with any product missing from the document store loads entirely from the database, so output does not change.

field.label: Serve Product Detail Pages From Documents
field.comment: Per store view: a product detail page takes its product from a document, so a configurable builds its variants, its options and its price without a query. The product itself still loads from the database, and a product missing from the document store renders entirely from it, so output does not change.
